channel.title: Daybrief
channel.description: AI first. Everything else that matters, twice a day.

item.title: JunWan666/astrbot-for-android: Deploy and manage AstrBot and NapCat locally on Android phones, with a built-in PRoot Ubuntu runtime environment, native management interface, WebUI, logs, backup and restore, and independent updates, no root required.
item.description: A Kotlin project for deploying and managing AstrBot and NapCat on Android phones, with a built-in PRoot Ubuntu runtime, backup and restore, and no root required. It has 105 GitHub stars. Why it matters: Shows that AI bot tools can run locally on a phone without root access, relevant to new GitHub projects.

item.title: The 50 top-funded AI startups in Asia
item.description: Here are the AI companies in Asia that have attracted tons of investors and have the resources to spend on software, talent, and expansion.

item.title: INFICON raises full-year guidance as semiconductor demand drives record sales
Novartis ADR earnings beat by $0.18, revenue fell short of estimates
The best PS2 emulator on Android can now make performance tweaks for you
item.description: ARMSX2 v2.9, an Android PS2 emulator, adds performance tuning that tries settings one at a time and keeps only those that speed up a game.

item.title: No further compromise to Alliance Medinet’s system, hacker access blocked, says parent company
item.description: Alliance Healthcare Group says the breach of Alliance Medinet's membership database, which affected about 110,000 members, is contained, with KPMG investigating.

item.title: OpenAI unveils 'GPT-6.1 Terra,' which handles PC operation quickly and at low cost
item.description: OpenAI announced GPT-6.1 Terra, available to Plus, Pro, Enterprise and Edu ChatGPT Work and Codex users, at $1 per million input tokens via API.

item.title: North Korean artillery pointed south stirs concern at border observatory
item.description: Visitors to a South Korean observatory saw North Korean artillery pointed south, as tensions rise after a September mine blast wounded three South Korean soldiers.

item.title: With Anthropic's 'largest IPO in history' imminent, Australia's largest bank may reap windfall of tens of billions of Australian dollars
item.description: Commonwealth Bank of Australia, which joined Anthropic's March 2025 funding round, is expected to sell shares as its stake grew to A$1.53 billion.

item.title: Attackers Hijack Dahua IP Cameras in Ukraine Using P2P Access and Auth Weaknesses
item.description: Ukraine's CERT-UA warns attackers are hijacking Dahua cameras and DVRs, mainly through the Easy4IP peer-to-peer platform and predictable serial numbers.

item.title: Nvidia to invest $3B in Meta stock, expand AI collaboration on Muse models
Circle faces up to 20% revenue risk from AI agents, Mizuho says
item.description: Mizuho cites a 10-20% medium-term downside risk to Circle's reserve revenue, as AI agents steer USDC holders toward higher-yielding fiat alternatives. Why it matters: A possible revenue hit for Circle as AI agents shift USDC holders elsewhere matters to markets and crypto investors.

item.title: GitHub rival Entire launches code hosting for AI agents
item.description: Entire, a GitHub rival, launched code hosting for AI agents, offering private repository hosting in the US, the EU, India, and Australia. Why it matters: A GitHub alternative built for AI agents, with private repositories hosted in several regions, relevant to agent developers.

item.title: Zcash co-founder proposes ending grants funding, citing $125 million treasury
item.description: Zcash co-founder Sean Bowe proposes ending automatic grant funding, redirecting it to a mining reserve, citing about $125 million available.

item.title: Nvidia, Meta partner on Muse agent as Nvidia invests $3 billion
item.description: Nvidia will invest $3 billion in Meta's equity offering, and the two will deepen work on Meta's Muse AI assistant and models.

item.title: vLLM Semantic Router Releases d3-ultra: A 27B Open Multimodal Decision Model
item.description: vLLM Semantic Router released d3-ultra, an open-weight 27B multimodal model that reads text, images and video and returns answer probabilities rather than generated text.

item.title: Thousands evacuate India's eastern coast ahead of Cyclone Arnab
item.description: Thousands have been evacuated along India's eastern coast ahead of Cyclone Arnab, which is expected to make landfall in Andhra Pradesh by Wednesday morning.

item.title: DBS Commits S$1 Million to Help Seniors, Migrant Workers Amid Haze
item.description: DBS is committing S$1 million to haze relief for seniors and migrant workers, with the initiative expected to benefit 275,000 people.

item.title: HSBC announces US$1 billion buyback after profit growth misses
item.description: HSBC announced a US$1 billion share buyback, its second consecutive quarterly one, after third-quarter pretax profit of US$9.6 billion missed estimates.

item.title: Baidu Open-Sources Unlimited OCR 2 for Hundred-Page Document Parsing
item.description: Baidu released Unlimited OCR 2, an MIT-licensed 3B model that parses hundred-page documents in one request, with weights and code available.

item.title: China's Unitree Robotics shares surge over 60% in less than two weeks despite industry risks warning
item.description: Unitree Robotics shares rose over 60% in under two weeks, to 672 yuan, as the company cautioned investors on humanoid robot risks.

item.title: T-Mobile’s new T-Mix plans are getting roasted by customers
item.description: T-Mobile's new T-Mix plans, starting at $55 to $95 a month, are drawing criticism from customers over a confusing "Picks" benefits system and restrictions.

item.title: Experts: since June, $100M+ in US data center freight has been stolen; in two successful heists, robbers struck escorts protecting trucks hauling $10M+ in goods
item.description: Trucking and security industry veterans told NBC News that more than $100 million in US data center freight has been stolen since June.

item.title: 3 scenarios for October 28: Which one breaks Bitcoin’s US$80,000 resistance
item.description: Bitcoin has traded in a narrow band between US$79,300 and US$80,000 ahead of the Federal Reserve's final rate decision on 28 October 2026.

item.title: HSBC quarterly profit jumps but shares slide after flat revenue for wealth business
item.description: HSBC's third-quarter profit surged 32 per cent on favourable interest rates and lower credit losses, but its shares fell 5 per cent after the results, which also showed flat wealth-division revenue. Why it matters: Strong bank results can hide a stalling wealth business, a sign that recent momentum is hard to sustain.

item.title: Microsoft patches a severe flaw in its Android Authenticator app that could let untrusted apps impersonate Microsoft apps and obtain delegated account tokens
item.description: Microsoft patched CVE-2026-80097 (CVSS 8.6) in Authenticator for Android, which could let apps with no declared permissions impersonate Microsoft apps and obtain work account access tokens. Microsoft classified it as a local elevation-of-privilege flaw. Why it matters: A flaw that could expose work account tokens on Android devices is relevant to anyone tracking CVEs and mobile security.

item.title: CISA Confirms Active Exploitation of Two PHP2Shell Flaws Enabling Remote Code Execution
item.description: CISA added two PHP2Shell flaws, both rated 9.2 on CVSS, allowing unauthenticated remote code execution to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog after confirmed attacks.

item.title: Paytm’s Q2 profit jumps to $24m as revenue grows
item.description: Paytm's Q2 profit rose to $24m as revenue grew, and it has started offering its in-house AI platform to enterprise merchants.

item.title: Position, Role or Label? A Controlled Study of Instruction Conflicts in LLM Agents
item.description: Across 14 open-weight models, the first of two conflicting instructions in one message usually wins, while instructions placed in separate messages win less often.

item.title: FlexA-Mem: Budget-Adaptive Agentic Memory for LLM Agents
item.description: FlexA-Mem stores history once and renders a fresh memory per call for LLM agents, beating the second-best method by 11.5% on AppWorld challenge tasks.

item.title: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB: A Hybrid Vision-Language Model for Local AI
item.description: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt is a hybrid vision-language model built with 2-bit quantization-aware distillation for memory-constrained local agent use, reporting higher accuracy than similar-footprint models.

item.title: StoneX lifts Strive price target 34% as new stock offering bolsters bitcoin strategy
item.description: StoneX raised its price target for bitcoin treasury company Strive to $43 from $32 and reiterated its Buy rating on the stock.

item.title: Seven Singapore-listed names among ‘global sector leaders’ in annual real estate ESG benchmark
item.description: Seven Singapore-listed real estate firms, including CapitaLand Ascott Trust and Hongkong Land, rank among the world's top-scored companies for sustainability in an annual benchmark.

item.title: S’pore aims to tighten haze law amid hurdles in gathering evidence, securing cooperation: Grace Fu
item.description: Singapore is looking to tighten its haze law, citing difficulties gathering evidence and securing cooperation from firms outside Singapore.

item.title: Vivian Balakrishnan visits Indonesia after natural gas cuts
item.description: Singapore's foreign minister is scheduled to meet his Indonesian counterpart in Jakarta on Tuesday, days after Indonesia trimmed natural gas exports to Singapore.

item.title: Bond market is a buy right now, J.P. Morgan Asset Management’s fixed income head says
item.description: Bob Michele of J.P. Morgan Asset Management says bonds are a buy, forecasting a 7% to 8% US return over 12 months.

item.description: Computers and sandboxes for your agents Discussion | Link

item.title: Singapore invests S$150 million in AI-driven materials discovery, launches support for business AI adoption
item.description: Singapore is investing S$150 million in Marvel-AI, a platform for discovering new materials across four material classes.

item.title: PulseDev
item.description: Launching today PulseDev Click any UI bug on localhost. 4 followers Click any UI bug on localhost.

item.title: Revix AI
item.description: Revix is an AI code reviewer that learns a repo's own rules, checks each pull request against them, and is free for public repos.

item.title: Opening Remarks by Minister for Energy, Trade and Industry (Energy and Industry) Dr Tan See Leng at the Singapore-IRENA High-Level Forum
item.description: Singapore's Tan See Leng says ASEAN needs around 26 gigawatts of renewables a year to hit its 2030 target, four times the past decade's pace.

item.title: Claude Cowork and chat come together for Enterprise
item.description: The unified Claude chat and Cowork experience is now generally available for Claude Enterprise plans, with agentic work running in a cloud environment.

item.title: Planning with Agents: Divided Worlds, Boundary Objects, and Thicker Interfaces
item.description: A talk arguing people must plan carefully with AI agents, since agents need an excellent plan to be productive while people are away.

item.title: daveebbelaar/bama: BAMA: Build Any Mac App. Agent skills to research, clone, design, build, optimize, and test native macOS apps…
item.description: BAMA is a set of agent skills that help build native macOS apps in Swift and SwiftUI, from idea to Dock. It plans user stories and builds one story per commit, with tests and light and dark snapshots. Why it matters: An example of AI coding agents being packaged as reusable skills for native Mac app development.

item.title: Nikkei Asia wins gold at WAN-IFRA Asian Media Awards
item.description: Nikkei Asia won gold at the WAN-IFRA Asian Media Awards for a series on the widening technology divide between the U.S. and China.

item.title: Tech earnings season heats up ahead of US midterms
item.description: A podcast discusses Big Tech earnings, whether AI firms can justify data center spending, and growing political opposition to data centers ahead of U.S. midterms.

item.title: The Oldest Windows App To Still Run On WIndows 11
item.description: Enlyth searched for the oldest Windows GUI app that still runs on Windows 11, landing on a 1992 CD player from early NT 3.1 builds.

item.title: Singapore-listed India ETF may help foreign investors on taxes
item.description: UTI Asset Management is launching a Singapore-listed ETF that invests in an India-listed fund, possibly offering foreign investors tax advantages.

item.title: Japan stands ready to take decisive action in currency market, finance minister says
Grab, Wise and Liquid Group First to Back Singapore Payments Code
item.description: Grab, Wise and Liquid Group are the first to sign Singapore's voluntary payments code, which aims to improve transparency and consumer protection.

item.title: Singapore, Germany to expand industrial AI cooperation as part of updated 5-pillar work plan
item.description: Singapore and Germany will expand industrial AI cooperation under an updated five-pillar work plan covering security, trade and energy, leaders said on Oct 27.

item.title: Anthropic’s soaring sales, steep losses put AI frenzy to IPO test
Earnings call transcript: AceVector posts 17% revenue growth in Q2 2026
RedotPay weighs confidential US IPO filing by year-end: Bloomberg
item.description: RedotPay reportedly weighs a confidential US IPO filing by end-2026 and is in talks on a pre-IPO round valuing it at $4–5 billion.

item.title: Broadcom CEO Hock Tan reportedly intervened to seal $63B Anthropic debt deal
Impress Releases 'AI Word Book' Carefully Selecting 190 Practical Terms Such as MCP and RAG
item.description: Impress has released 'AI Word Book,' an AI glossary of 190 terms, including MCP and RAG, designed for use in real workplace settings. Why it matters: Clear definitions of AI terms like MCP and RAG help readers who follow AI tools at work.

item.title: UOB Targets S$900M in AI Value by 2030 Under Singapore Programme
item.description: UOB aims to generate S$900 million in economic value from AI by 2030 through Enterprise Singapore's Champions of AI programme.

item.title: Singapore launches AI platform to develop industrial materials, backed by about $150 mil
item.description: Singapore launched MARVEL-AI, an AI platform backed by about $150 million, to help manufacturers judge whether new materials can be made at scale.

item.title: Iron ore declines to two-year low as demand outlook weakens
item.description: Iron ore fell to its lowest level in over two years on a weaker demand outlook and rising supply.
